<infobox theme="Sport">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="createdby"><label>Created by</label></data>	
        <data source="type"><label>Type of sport</label></data>	
        <data source="regulator"><label>Regulating authority</label></data>	
        <data source="associated"><label>Associated organizations</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Organizational information</header>
        <data source="participants"><label>Number of participants</label></data>
        <data source="teams"><label>Notable teams</label></data>	
        <data source="players"><label>Notable players</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Sport|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
